messages:
alex: Heads-up — our GPU commitment coverage in eu-west-1 drops sharply on 2026-07-01. Several Standard RIs expire and if we don't act we'll see ~+115k/mo in on-demand spend (rough estimate). We need a quick decision on replacement vs migration.

maria: Which SKUs specifically? I can run utilization queries and a 90-day look.

alex: Mostly p4d.24xlarge and a handful of p3dn.24xlarge. Breakdown: 12 p4d RIs end 2026-07-01, 8 p3dn end 2026-07-10. Current RI coverage ~82% for those instance classes; after expiry it falls to ~45%.

kevin: Are these Standard RIs or Savings Plans? Any convertible RIs in the mix?

alex: They're regional Standard RIs, not convertible. We have a small Compute Savings Plan that covers ~26% of GPU spend (legacy). Buying a Compute SP would cover more but requires a commitment level.

maria: Quick Cost Explorer command I use to validate coverage: `aws ce get-reservation-coverage --time-period Start=2026-01-01,End=2026-06-30 --granularity=MONTHLY --group-by Type=INSTANCE_TYPE` — also run `aws ce get-rightsizing-recommendation` for underutilized instances.

kevin: Options to consider: (A) staggered replacement with 12-month convertible reservations for p4d to keep flexibility, (B) buy 3-year standard to maximize savings, (C) move non-regulated batch training to regions with spare Dedicated capacity or spot pools. We should also evaluate the cashflow impact.

alex: Region constraints matter: ~40% of our EU training workload must stay in eu-west-1 for data residency. But non-PII batch loads (~30% of GPU hours) can be moved to us-east-1 or to our Dedicated pools during off-peak.

ops-ana: Proposal/action items: (1) Maria — run per-instance-type utilization + 90-day tail and export CSV (owner: maria), (2) Kevin/finance — build 1yr vs 3yr vs on-demand model including cashflow and break-even (owner: kevin), (3) Alex/infra — identify candidates for spot/backfill and estimate migration effort (owner: alex).

maria: I'll run the queries tonight and post the CSV in this thread. Example query I use against our billing dataset: `SELECT usage_start_date, resource_id, usage_amount, instance_type FROM aws_cost_and_usage WHERE product = 'AmazonEC2' AND usage_type LIKE '%GPU%'` — will include 95th-percentile sustained usage per resource.

kevin: :thumbsup: Also let's ensure tagging hygiene — add `billing:owner`, `env`, `workload-type` on all GPU instances so forecasting sticks. Finance flagged several orphaned instances in last month.

alex: Agree. If no objections, I'm leaning to a hybrid approach: 12-month convertible for p4d to buy time and move ~30% batch out of eu-west-1 to reduce future commitment size. I'll draft slides with 3 scenarios (no-buy, 1yr convertible, 3yr standard) and estimated ROI by EOM.

kevin: Sounds reasonable. Finance will need the exact CSV to run numbers.

alex: OK — Maria runs queries, Kevin builds the model, I'll schedule a 30-min decision sync Friday 10:00 CET. If anyone has other ideas (e.g., exchanging into smaller instance families or negotiating with cloud rep for coupon/partner credits), shout here.

maria: Uploading CSV later today.

kevin: I'll ping finance and CC sales-eng for any enterprise discount leverage.

alex: Thanks everyone. Closing for now — we'll reconvene with data.
